entry.title: A New Method for Numerical Solution of the Fractional Relaxation and Subdiffusion Equations Using Fractional Taylor Polynomials
entry.summary: The accuracy of the numerical solution of a fractional differential equation depends on the differentiability class of the solution. The derivatives of the solutions of fractional differential equations often have a singularity at the initial point, which may result in a lower accuracy of the numerical solutions. We propose a method for improving the accuracy of the numerical solutions of the fractional relaxation and subdiffusion equations based on the fractional Taylor polynomials of the solution at the initial point.
